title: Certifying Almost-Sure Reachability in Unknown MDPs
abstract: arXiv:2610.18119v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: {\em Specification-Guided Reinforcement Learning (RL)} has largely concerned itself with \emph{learning} an optimal policy against a formal specification in an unknown {\em Markov Decision Process (MDP)}. We take up the dual question. Given a policy already in hand, can one \emph{verify} that it is correct against a formal specification in an unknown MDP, using sampling access alone? Such a question arises naturally in safety-critical systems. We investigate it for the {\em almost-sure reachability property}, whose correctness is witnessed by a {\em ranking supermartingale (RSM)} certificate. Our first finding is negative. In the absence of any further information about the MDP, one can neither learn such a certificate nor verify a candidate one with probabilistic guarantees. On the positive side, we show that, under a mild restriction, a known lower bound $p_{\min}$ on nonzero transition probabilities, a correct certificate \emph{can}

translated_title: 在未知马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中认证几乎必然可达性
translated_abstract: 规范引导强化学习（RL）主要关注在未知马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）中，针对形式规范学习最优策略。我们则研究其对偶问题：给定一个已有的策略，能否仅通过采样访问，在未知MDP中验证该策略是否满足形式规范？这样的问题在安全关键系统中自然产生。我们针对几乎必然可达性性质展开研究，其正确性可以由排序上鞅（Ranking Supermartingale，RSM）证书来证明。我们的第一个发现是负面的：在缺乏关于MDP任何进一步信息的情况下，人们既无法学习这样的证书，也无法以概率保证验证一个候选证书。从积极方面来看，我们证明，在一个温和的限制条件下——即已知非零转移概率的下界 p_min——正确的证书可以被[验证]……
tldr: 本文研究在未知MDP中仅通过采样访问验证给定策略是否满足几乎必然可达性，证明了在无额外信息时无法学习或验证RSM证书，但在已知非零转移概率下界的温和条件下可以实现验证。
en_tdlr: This paper studies verifying whether a given policy satisfies almost-sure reachability in an unknown MDP using sampling access alone, showing that learning or verifying RSM certificates is impossible without additional information, but becomes achievable under the mild condition of a known lower bound on nonzero transition probabilities.
